tbilisi-rustavi-ponichala-sutip.why: Land acquisition and resettlement plans LARP 2a and 2b governed the buy-outs (safeguard); ADB's Compliance Review Panel imposed a remedial action plan after finding non-compliance in six areas (admin).

peshawar-landfill-ghari-faiz-ullah.why: ADB required an Implementable Corrective Action Plan 'to bring the subproject in compliance with the ADB SPS requirements to enable the subproject to be considered for ADB financing' - the SPS compliance duty (safeguard) and the required plan with its PKR 238,752,828 budget (admin).

sahiwal-piciip-land-and-sewage.why: The project 'is category B for environment, A for involuntary resettlement and C for Indigenous Peoples', and ADB screened Lot 2 as category C for involuntary resettlement on the basis that the sewer works needed no land acquisition - the lender's own safeguard classification (safeguard).

batumi-bypass-land-valuation.why: Categorised A for environment and A for involuntary resettlement, and 'Land was bought out under land acquisition and resettlement plans administered by the Roads Department'.

ache-finca-470-ruta-10.why: The Environmental Sub-Program required Paraguay to buy 20,000 ha for forest reserves and 11,000 ha to regularise indigenous land ownership (land), as an offset for the likely ecological and social impacts of the road works (safeguard); the December 1995 Environmental Summary set conditions before loan approval and before first disbursement, including a land-titling plan naming the communities, hectares, funding and a timetable (admin).

nis-railway-bypass-min-holding-tenants.why: A Resettlement Action Plan adopted in October 2019 set out tenant-purchase of the flats followed by expropriation for the five remaining tenant families.

bogota-metro-line1-predios.why: Property acquisition and relocation for Line 1 were carried out under the project's Resettlement Plan, the complaint turning on who the plan covered.

guiyang-youxiao-road-resettlement.why: The loan triggered OP 4.12 and OP 4.20; a Resettlement Action Plan and an Indigenous Peoples Development Plan were written and published before approval, and the December 2012 restructuring added a legal covenant so the Bank could keep monitoring resettlement until it was finished.

guiguang-railway-land-acquisition.why: Category A, four safeguard policies triggered besides environmental assessment; a Resettlement Action Plan and an Ethnic Minority Development Plan published before approval, the plan rewritten for the new alignment with three Supplemental Income Programmes added.

liuzhan-railway-resettlement.why: Category A with OP 4.01, OP 4.04 and OP 4.12 triggered, and the loan was not negotiated until the Ministry of Railways had agreed with Guizhou and Yunnan who would fund the resettlement action plan and how it would be carried out.

shiyan-connecting-road-safeguards.why: Environmental Category A, and 'Resettlement was carried out under a Resettlement Action Plan', with independent monitoring (safeguard).

chebei-village-guangzhou-resettlement.why: Category A with involuntary resettlement for the land needed for the treatment plants and sewers, and Resettlement Action Plans prepared for the components.

jituhun-railway-resettlement.why: Category A with five policies triggered, including OP 4.10 and OP 4.12, and 'A Resettlement Action Plan with grievance handling procedures and internal and external monitoring, and an Ethnic Minority Development Plan integrated with it, were written and published before approval' (safeguard).

shizheng-railway-resettlement.why: Category A with OP 4.01 and OP 4.12 triggered; a socio-economic assessment and a Resettlement Plan with household relocation and livelihood restoration schemes prepared at appraisal on consultation with the households.

orissa-state-roads-compensation.why: Category A with OP 4.10, OP 4.11 and OP 4.12 triggered, and the resettlement policy the project adopted made squatter tenants, and partly affected squatters, ineligible for resettlement assistance.

karnataka-state-highways-ii-compensation.why: Category A, OP 4.12 and OP 4.11 triggered; a resettlement policy framework and action plans prepared, the policy changed in 2014 to fit India's new land acquisition law, and an extra 25 per cent compensation paid to landowners who accepted the rates offered.

himachal-pradesh-state-roads-debris.why: Category A with five safeguard policies triggered - environmental assessment, natural habitats, physical cultural resources, involuntary resettlement and forests - and 'Resettlement action plans were prepared for each road package' (safeguard).

lucknow-muzaffarpur-highway-land.why: Entitlements were to be delivered under a resettlement action plan for each phase under operational directive 3.40, and the Bank agreed to keep monitoring resettlement on corridor sections it did not finance under the project agreement.

biftu-quarry-mizan-dima-road.why: Environmental and social impact assessments, resettlement action plans and environmental and social management plans were required for each civil works site and contractors required to prepare site-specific plans (safeguard); the Bank's partial suspension of disbursement was lifted only on completion of an agreed action plan (admin).

mekenajo-dembidolo-road-coffee.why: Category A with four safeguard policies triggered; contractors were required to prepare site-specific environmental management plans within 28 days of starting work and to root slope grassing before leaving site.

caldwell-bridge-liberia-compensation.why: OP/BP 4.12 was the social policy triggered, under which the government was to compensate affected people before sites were cleared and handed to contractors, with resettlement action plans governing each road.

shaanxi-ankang-road-resettlement.why: OP 4.12 triggered, with Resettlement Plans and a Resettlement Policy Framework prepared before approval, compensation rates set to reflect regulations and restoration demands, and about 120 consultation meetings.

huai-river-flood-drainage-resettlement.why: OP 4.12, OP 4.11 and OP 4.04 triggered, and 'a full resettlement action plan was prepared and carried out for each subproject', social provisions written into every construction contract, and internal and external monitors engaged (safeguard).

liaoning-medium-cities-resettlement.why: The policy on involuntary resettlement was triggered, a resettlement plan prepared before approval, an independent consulting firm monitored the whole process, and supervision missions checked compensation for people with and without land titles as set in the plan.

nanguang-railway-resettlement.why: OP 4.12, natural habitats and physical cultural resources triggered; a resettlement action plan published before approval on an impact inventory, a census and consultations, and disclosed through a government website, local newspapers and Bank offices.

cuijiaying-han-river-resettlement.why: Policies on involuntary resettlement, safety of dams and cultural property triggered, with a resettlement action plan and an environmental management plan prepared before approval and environmental measures written into the contract documents.

naji-youjiang-waterways-resettlement.why: Resettlement plans prepared for both components before approval with a resettlement supervisor and an external monitor engaged (safeguard); environmental monitoring reports sent to the Bank regularly as the project agreement required (admin).

vietnam-rural-energy-2-land-loss.why: OP 4.12 and the indigenous peoples policy triggered, with a resettlement policy framework, over twenty provincial plans and compensation at substitution cost (safeguard); the appraisal document records that the project required a waiver by the Vietnamese government of articles of its own decrees and regulations on compensation and resettlement (law).

vietnam-water-resources-assistance-reset.why: Category A with seven safeguard policies triggered, a resettlement framework and seven detailed resettlement plans for the six schemes, and an ethnic minority development plan required where minority households were affected.

vietnam-distribution-efficiency-five-hou.why: OP 4.12 and OP 4.10 triggered, with a resettlement policy framework, an ethnic minority policy framework, resettlement action plans and ethnic minority development plans prepared, cleared and published, and disclosure required in Vietnamese locally and in English at the InfoShop.

nhiip-india-corridor-land-acquisition.why: OP 4.12 and OP 4.10 triggered, with corridor-specific resettlement action plans under a policy framework and indigenous peoples development plans folded into them (safeguard); 'The project required contractors to be handed 80 per cent of the land free of encumbrance within a set period' (land).

hunan-urban-development-wwtp-resettlemen.why: Environmental assessment, involuntary resettlement and cultural property triggered at category A and safeguard category S2; eight resettlement action plans plus a policy framework disclosed, and the loan paid for an independent third party to monitor the social safeguards.

chongqing-small-cities-qianjiang-resettl.why: Environmental assessment, involuntary resettlement and dam safety triggered, resettlement action plans prepared, and Chongqing Technology and Business University appointed external independent monitoring agent for the social safeguards.

sichuan-urban-development-four-cities.why: Environmental assessment and involuntary resettlement triggered at category A, each municipality preparing and disclosing its own resettlement action plan, an indigenous peoples plan prepared, the Bank's Resettlement Committee reviewing and endorsing the approach, and a university expert team monitoring twice a year (safeguard).

wuxikou-reservoir-chitan-resettlement.why: OP 4.12 and the dam safety policy triggered, a resettlement action plan 'prepared and later updated with the Bank's approval', external monitoring by Hohai University sociologists, and compensation set by the plan as a homestead plot and 0.04 ha of farmland per economically displaced person with a 20-year support programme (safeguard).

da-nang-sustainable-city-164-pending.why: Environmental assessment, physical cultural resources and involuntary resettlement triggered at category B, with a resettlement policy framework and six resettlement action plans 'prepared and disclosed', compensation 'based on replacement cost surveys by an independent appraiser' and entitlement matrices in the site-specific plans (safeguard).

vietnam-medium-cities-phu-ly-noncomplian.why: Indigenous peoples, physical and cultural resources and involuntary resettlement triggered, with each city preparing a resettlement policy framework and resettlement plans disclosed locally and at the InfoShop, and an ethnic minority development plan prepared for Lao Cai city (safeguard).

vietnam-natural-disaster-risk-989-resett.why: Five safeguard policies plus indigenous peoples triggered; a resettlement policy framework prepared under OP 4.12 with action plans for the first-year subprojects, an ethnic minority policy framework, and an independent monitoring consultant reviewing how the social safeguards were implemented.

bumbuna-hydro-reservoir-resettlement.why: Six safeguard policies triggered and an exception to the Bank's resettlement policy granted so IDA grant money could pay legacy compensation for the 1990s transmission line foundations (safeguard); a special account set up for transmission line compensation, to be used once a legal framework existed (fincov).

kibera-mukuru-railway-relocation.why: The project funded a relocation action plan to clear a safety zone, the Bank pressing for a 10.4 m cleared strip and the January 2011 plan setting the right of way and the resettlement widths (safeguard); 'the government agreed to put about US$860,000 from the remaining credit into an escrow account for owners of multiple plots' (fincov).

kawanda-masaka-line-galatiya.why: A resettlement action plan for the 137 km line was disclosed and 'The Bank's resettlement policy required compensation before any civil works began' (safeguard); 'The government set up an escrow account to fund compensation payments' (fincov).

upper-cisokan-pumped-storage-land.why: The loan agreement said the borrower must ensure component 2, land acquisition and resettlement, 'is financed exclusively out of its own or other resources and not out' of the Bank loan (fincov); three land acquisition and resettlement action plans prepared under OP 4.12, cleared by the Bank in 2011 and still monitored after the 2018 restructuring (safeguard).

kisip-informal-settlements-fatalities.why: A resettlement policy framework disclosed and re-disclosed, with settlement-level resettlement action plans required wherever work displaced people (safeguard); 'The Bank also required that land titles not be released until land for the affected people had been identified and surveyed' (land).

lower-nzoia-irrigation-unpaid-compensati.why: Four resettlement action plans prepared by the borrower and cleared by the Bank (safeguard); the restructuring allowed land compensation to be paid from IDA funds only through a special-purpose account separate from the government's pooled account, which meant opening a dedicated National Land Commission bank account (fincov).

rsdp-apl3-road-deaths.why: Category A with environmental assessment and involuntary resettlement triggered; environmental impact assessments and resettlement action plans prepared for each road under a policy framework, and contractors bound by environmental monitoring plans with internal and external monitoring.

uganda-ert2-grid-compensation.why: The involuntary resettlement policy was triggered, a resettlement policy framework and an environmental and social management framework were prepared at appraisal, and 'The resettlement policy required that compensation be paid in full before any civil works began'.

ceip-polder-land-payments-bangladesh.why: A Social Management and Resettlement Policy Framework and a draft resettlement action plan disclosed, 'the financing agreement required the borrower to carry out the project in accordance with that framework and the environmental management framework', and 'No construction was to be carried out on a site until land acquisition and compensation there were complete' (safeguard); because the credit was to pay land acquisition and resettlement costs, approval was required from the Bank's Regional Vice Presidency 'for the use of credit proceeds to reimburse those costs' (fincov).

lahore-walled-city-shop-removals.why: An Environmental and Social Management Framework and a Resettlement Framework governed the works, with the entitlement matrix set on OP 4.12, a cut-off date, compensation about one month before any shop or plot was taken, no taking without full payment, disputed amounts pledged in the affected person's favour, and the contractor able to start only after the project took the site over.

nepal-road-sector-unpaid-compensation.why: An Environmental and Social Management Framework with an initial environmental examination and environmental management plan 'required for each road', compensation to be completed before the start of any civil works, and a draft plan submitted to the Bank and 'to be disclosed before the project became effective' (safeguard); the Department of Roads' Geo-Environmental and Social Unit 'was to monitor impacts after construction' (admin).

swat-s3b-road-land-acquisition.why: The Multi Donor Trust Fund's Environmental and Social Screening and Assessment Framework 'applied in place of the usual project-specific safeguard instruments', with an environmental impact assessment and management plan per phase submitted to the Bank, the supervision consultants 'contractually bound to implement the management plan', and the right of way held to the design minimum (safeguard); 'Trust fund money cannot normally pay compensation, so approval was sought from, and given by, the Bank's Regional Vice President to pay compensation ... from the grant' (fincov).

siddhirganj-pipeline-transmission-land.why: Cleared environmental and social assessments, environmental management plans and resettlement action plans 'were conditions of loan negotiations', no civil works were to start before compensation was given, and the list of affected people and amounts had to be published on both companies' websites (safeguard); losses 'were to be assessed by a Compensation Determination Committee' including a representative of the affected people and of an NGO (admin).

gujarat-highway-ii-delayed-compensation.why: Resettlement action plans for the eight corridors and an Indigenous People's Development Plan with free, prior and informed consultation, and a framework setting market value for land, replacement cost for structures, allowances for people without title and annual updating of the amounts (safeguard); cash land and resettlement costs to come from Government of Gujarat funds with loan money paying only for the consultancies, goods and works needed to carry the plans out (fincov); loan covenants requiring every permit and clearance before civil works, quarterly safeguard reporting and a district-level grievance redress mechanism (admin).

dehlon-bypass-uncompensated-landowner.why: A Resettlement and Rehabilitation Policy Framework with an entitlement matrix adopted and plans disclosed before appraisal, and a covenant barring civil works at a site until physical relocation there was complete to the Bank's satisfaction, with first-phase relocation due by 5 June 2008 (safeguard); the covenant that neither framework nor plans be revised or set aside without the Bank's prior approval (admin).

salem-tnudp-squatter-resettlement.why: An Environmental and Social Framework, approved by Government of Tamil Nadu order and treated as meeting OP 4.12, screened each sub-project for the plan it needed (safeguard); for the Chennai works the state financing company reviewed and approved the plans, the Bank had to issue a no-objection before bidding, a works contract could be signed only once the land was clear and the plan fully carried out, and two environmental and social audits were done (admin).

assam-roads-uncompensated-acquisition.why: A state resettlement and rehabilitation policy and entitlement matrix consistent with Bank policy, a resettlement policy framework, disclosed action plans and an Indigenous Peoples Development Plan, with work on one package suspended until the compensation was completed and the money transferred (safeguard); the Public Works Roads Department to staff an Environment and Social Cell, engage a local NGO, and have supervision consultants monitor and an independent consultant evaluate (admin).

drc-selembao-loange-compensation.why: A programmatic process of screening, assessment, consultation, disclosure and approval applied the policies case by case, and the Loange resettlement and compensation plan under OP 4.12 and the financing agreement commitments had to be carried out, with payment before work started and a cut-off date (safeguard); an environmental consulting firm hired to manage the environmental and social management plan, and implementation by an independent expert recruited by BCMI assisted by a resettlement committee (admin).

ghana-urban-water-unpaid-compensation.why: An environmental assessment management plan, a resettlement policy framework and a dam safety report prepared before appraisal, with staff trained to prepare resettlement action plans during construction (safeguard); a dated covenant added at restructuring required the borrower to set up an escrow account used only for compensation and disturbance allowances, for full compensation before works were implemented (fincov).

burkina-donsin-airport-roads-resettlemen.why: The environmental and social impact assessment, its management plan and the resettlement action plan were disclosed and to be carried out before the road works started, with new village sites, improved houses, a year's lost farm income and training agreed in the plan (safeguard); a condition required the airport project authority MOAD to adopt a manual of procedures within three months and not change it without the Bank's written consent (admin).

rwanda-rssp2-marshland-resettlement.why: Riparian notification under the international waterways policy, an Environmental and Social Management Framework with a screening tool 'applied to each funding request', and a Resettlement Policy Framework that 'set the rules for preparing a resettlement action plan for any sub-project that displaced people', with thirteen plans prepared and compensation under Rwandan law and OP 4.12, including land given in exchange for land (safeguard).

south-west-roads-turkestan-sairam-compen.why: Reclassification to category A meant the Bank's policies required a full environmental assessment and resettlement action plans before appraisal; a Board waiver was sought instead, on the understanding the assessment and a policy framework would be finished before Board and site-specific plans prepared during construction, and the March 2011 plan committed the borrower to compensate land users without formal title on the same terms as those with title.

hanoi-ring-road-2-relocation.why: Category A under the environmental assessment policy with OP 4.12 also triggered; a resettlement policy framework and action plan prepared in line with Bank policy and disclosed, updated at the first restructuring, with an outside agency monitoring independently and reporting every three months.

bahia-viver-melhor-ii-resettlement.why: A resettlement framework with an action plan for Alagados VI, and households moved off high-risk ground to be offered cash compensation, assisted purchase with the project monitoring it, or a newly built house within one kilometre of the old homes, with disputes going to court for judicial compensation.

rurrenabaque-airport-land-compensation.why: Six safeguard policies triggered with the matching instruments prepared to the Bank's requirements, the Bank hiring a third party to bring the valuation of the expropriated land into line with the safeguard policies, and civil works not starting until the compensation question was settled.

philippines-nrimp2-unpaid-land-claims.why: The Social and Environmental Management System applied and the department's existing land acquisition, resettlement and indigenous peoples framework was accepted as consistent with OP 4.12 and OP 4.10, with Bank policy requiring compensation claims paid before construction began, including on linked works built with government money (safeguard); multi-partite monitoring teams set up between the project office, the Environmental and Social Safeguard Office and regional offices, and an action plan later agreed with the Bank that cut the right of way back (admin).

sichuan-small-towns-unfinished-resettlem.why: Individual resettlement action plans with a summary plan disclosed locally and at the InfoShop, and an independent external resettlement monitoring agent paid for under the loan's capacity-building component (safeguard); a supplementary resettlement action plan agreed between Sichuan and the Bank at closing, with signed commitment letters from local governments and continued external monitoring under contract (admin).

qufu-gupan-pond-demolition.why: Category B with environmental assessment, physical cultural resources and involuntary resettlement triggered, a resettlement action plan before approval and an abbreviated plan at restructuring, both disclosed, an external monitoring team reporting twice a year on OP 4.12 compliance and a further external monitoring contract added at restructuring, with the site also under UNESCO's buffer-zone requirements (safeguard).

xiangyang-panggong-resettlement-housing-.why: A resettlement action plan and policy framework prepared and disclosed before appraisal, an environmental management plan adopted by the municipal government and an external environmental monitoring consultant hired, with twelve monitoring reports sent to the Bank (safeguard); the Bank required the project office to coordinate with the other agencies and to provide a detailed resettlement progress report for the four delayed contracts until the issues were resolved (admin).

nanning-urban-environment-resettlement.why: Separate, consolidated and framework resettlement plans prepared and disclosed in China and at Bank headquarters, with the indigenous peoples policy triggered and a social assessment concluding no plan was needed (safeguard); the project office committed by letter of 10 April 2017 to coordinate on the outstanding land certificates, send the Bank photocopies and report every six months until they were issued (admin).

liaoning-coastal-zone-resettlement.why: Category A with involuntary resettlement triggered, a consolidated plan, site-specific plans and land acquisition due diligence reports disclosed locally and at the InfoShop, outside compliance monitoring by a consulting firm, and the Bank accepting land use due diligence in place of a resettlement plan for the 2018 Kuandian additions (safeguard).

han-river-urban-environment-resettlement.why: An environmental impact assessment per component and resettlement action plans per city or county, drawn up in consultation with displaced people and publicly disclosed before appraisal, with a social assessment in each affected village and an external resettlement monitoring consultants' group contracted to supervise implementation.

second-shandong-environment-resettlement.why: Category A with involuntary resettlement triggered, resettlement action plans prepared in consultation and publicly disclosed, implementation 'monitored from outside the project by the Shandong Construction Development and Research Institute, as the legal agreements required', and an environmental assessment and management plan prepared 'to national and Bank requirements' (safeguard).

shanghai-urban-environment-apl2-resettle.why: A resettlement action plan for each subproject, an independent third-party social development consultant team monitoring all social safeguard activity and reporting to the project office and the Bank, and the Minhang component dropped once OP 4.12 would have been triggered, with the borrower undertaking to complete the closures from its own funds and run a five-year independent environmental monitoring programme.

liuzhou-environment-management-resettlem.why: OP 4.12 triggered with resettlement action plans prepared, external monitoring by the Shanghai Academy of Social Science reporting every six months, public participation and valuation hearings, a complaint mechanism and assistance for vulnerable households (safeguard); 'Compensation could be paid only from the borrower's counterpart funds' (fincov).

zhanghu-railway-resettlement.why: The one legal covenant binds the borrower, through the Ministry of Railways, to implement the project in accordance with the safeguards instruments in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Bank and to monitor them every six months, the resettlement action plan, policy framework and social assessment being what the covenant makes binding (safeguard); procurement plans and any change to them had to go to the Bank for prior review and no objection before use (admin).

luan-huaibei-urban-transport-resettlemen.why: Anhui had to make each city carry out its resettlement action plan and environmental management plan and hire consultants to monitor them, send the Bank the results every six months and act on their recommendations (safeguard); Anhui and the four cities had to keep an adequate organisational structure, prepare annual work plans, hire supervision consultants and furnish six-monthly reports and a mid-term report by 15 August 2013 (admin); the loan had to be on-lent to Anhui and from Anhui to the four cities on the same terms, with the municipalities carrying the currency risk (fincov).

zhegan-line-railway-resettlement.why: The sole condition of effectiveness was a legal opinion that the resettlement arrangements between the Ministry of Railways and Hunan, Jiangxi and Zhejiang were legally binding, with standing duties to minimise involuntary loss of shelter, assets, income or livelihood, carry out the environmental management and resettlement plans satisfactorily, and send any change to the Bank for approval (safeguard); covenants on power supply agreements, the train timetable, operating rules, twice-yearly financial monitoring reports, and the technical assistance studies' terms of reference, annual recommendations and action plans (admin).

nanchang-line-2-demolition.why: A covenant required the implementing entity to make Nanchang Municipality and the Urban Rail Company carry out the safeguards instruments in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Bank, and under OP 4.12 a resettlement action plan and policy framework were prepared and disclosed, the covenant covering the demolition whoever paid for it (safeguard); the condition of effectiveness that a subsidiary agreement be executed, the duty to keep a Project Leading Group and Project Management Office, to carry out the Integration Plan as approved, and six-monthly, interim and audited financial reporting (admin).

henan-towns-water-land-acquisition.why: The project agreement required Henan, the counties and the water companies to minimise involuntary loss of shelter, assets, income or livelihood and to implement the resettlement action plan satisfactorily before any works began, with no change or waiver without the Bank's prior agreement, independent monitoring agencies acceptable to the Bank, and six-monthly environmental, dam safety and resettlement reports (safeguard); effectiveness conditions of eight subsidiary loan agreements and financial management training, Bank prior review of bidding contracts, improvement action plans for low-performing water companies and reservoir remedial works with operating and monitoring procedures by 31 December 2006 (admin); a financial covenant requiring each water company to earn revenues at least equal to operating expenses plus the excess of debt service over depreciation plus its own capital spending, and a disbursement covenant limiting spending to counties with a signed subsidiary loan agreement (fincov).

sichuan-wudu-canal-resettlement.why: Sichuan had to apply the resettlement action plan, environmental management plan, pest management plan and dam safety action plan satisfactorily with no amendment, suspension or waiver without the Bank's agreement, carry out measures satisfactory to the Bank for improving displaced persons' living standards, keep independent consultants monitoring and reporting annually from outside the project, and write enforcement of the environmental plan with penalties into works contracts (safeguard); keeping the leading groups and project offices in place to 31 December 2017, six-monthly reporting, a mid-term review by 30 June 2015, a procurement and financial management information system within 45 days, operation and maintenance plans, water user associations under the association manual, and a programme for extending the community-driven approach funded by Mianyang City (admin). Also a covenant for a programme extending the community-driven approach beyond the demonstration areas, 'with Mianyang City made to fund it' - an obligation to provide money, of the same kind as Henan's self-financing covenant and Tongliang's duty to fund counterpart requirements and debt service (fincov).

yining-urban-roads-demolition.why: Yining Municipality had to carry out the environmental management plan, the resettlement action plan and the Ethnic Minority Development Plan, the resettlement plan being required because OP 4.12 requires one where a project takes land and demolishes housing (safeguard); it also had to keep an adequate organisational structure, send six-monthly project reports and six-monthly progress reports on those three plans, and a mid-term progress report by 30 June 2015 (admin).

tongliang-road-land-lease-compensation.why: Six resettlement action plans prepared under OP 4.12 with a consolidated plan translated for the Bank's review and approval, and the project agreement duty to minimise involuntary loss and implement the plan satisfactorily before any works began, with a new plan for any displacing design change, independent monitoring agencies acceptable to the Bank reporting six-monthly, and no modification or waiver without the Bank's prior agreement (safeguard); the disbursement condition that subsidiary loan or implementation agreements be signed, keeping the Chongqing project management office and local units staffed, a mid-term review, and showing the Bank a clinic met municipal standards before equipment was delivered (admin); on-lending the proceeds on terms satisfactory to the Bank and providing adequate funding for counterpart requirements, debt repayments and operations and maintenance (fincov).

guangxi-poor-rural-land-acquisition.why: Each province had to carry out the project in accordance with the project implementation manual acceptable to the Bank, which contained the environmental management plan, the resettlement policy framework and an ethnic minority planning framework with six development plans, with no part amendable without the Bank's prior agreement, and resettlement action plans prepared for the first year's works (safeguard); three conditions of effectiveness, disbursement held back province by province until county project office staff were trained satisfactorily to the Bank, the leading group and project offices kept staffed, annual action and work plans by 31 October, participatory assessments under guidelines satisfactory to the Bank, annual progress reports, audits and a mid-term report by 1 September 2008 (admin); covenants that at least half of cumulative project spending fall on components 2 to 6 and that farmers not be required to contribute to cost recovery for them (fincov).

rogun-stage1-resettlement.why: A Resettlement Policy Framework prepared alongside the Stage 1 plan for use on Stage 2, a separate Resettlement Audit commissioned to examine resettlement already done and inform retroactive measures needed to meet the Bank's involuntary resettlement policy, and a three-step grievance procedure set out in the plan.

kwabenya-landfill-expropriation.why: The Development Credit Agreement required a detailed resettlement action plan acceptable to the Bank, the obligation to compensate affected people in accordance with Bank policy survived the landfill's abandonment and the project's closing, the framework required compensation and resettlement before the confirming instrument on the land acquisition was passed, and the Bank insisted compensation be paid only after the plan was completed and accepted.

santa-fe-road-19-expropriation.why: A detailed environmental and social management plan and a Resettlement and Expropriation Plan, which divided impacts, ran socio-economic analysis where more than 40 per cent of a property was taken, and produced a re-establishment programme for the 26 cases (safeguard); 'The province was to expropriate land to reach a right of way of 120 metres', with whole-property expropriation where the remainder was left unviable (land).

sutp-brts-corridor-displacement.why: OP/BP 4.01, 4.11 and 4.12 triggered, with affected religious structures supervised under the involuntary resettlement policy and their owners compensated as part of land acquisition with additional support for reconstruction, under a Resettlement Action Plan and Environmental Management Plan the review calls rushed.

dar-brt-kariakoo-clearance.why: OP/BP 4.01 and 4.12 triggered, with an environmental and social impact assessment and a Resettlement Action Plan built from a census, a property survey and a socio-economic survey, and environmental and social management plans for all components.

nutrip-road-compensation-arrears.why: OP/BP 4.01, 4.12 and 4.11 triggered, resettlement action plans prepared and updated for each section, and the Bank's letter of 5 March 2019 confirming that the Government's obligation to carry out the disclosed resettlement and environmental instruments and to set aside adequate funds for them survived the credit's cancellation.

bukoba-airport-resettlement-arrears.why: OP/BP 4.12 and OP 4.11 triggered with resettlement action plans prepared for every airport, the Arusha town section excluded from the works because resettlement would have been required, an archaeologist expected under the cultural property policy, and construction companies required to put HIV prevention education and sensitisation plans in place with district health officers.

shaying-river-sanba-village-resettlement.why: OP 4.12 was triggered and 'meant a resettlement plan with a resettlement policy framework had to be prepared, and it was', with independent consultants commissioned to monitor the social safeguards (safeguard); the appraisal document's covenants section lists standard covenants 'relating to procurement, financial management and safeguards', and the completion report sets out the reporting that went with them - interim financial reports, annual audited reports, periodic safeguards reports and regular progress reports in agreed formats (admin). The 'No non-standard conditions' line is the appraisal template's term for conditions beyond the Bank's standard ones and stays in the prose.

kolkata-keiip-tranche2-vendors.why: ADB's own category classification for the project — B for environment, B for involuntary resettlement, C for Indigenous Peoples — which is the lender's safeguard requirement framework. The sentence sits in the lender role rather than in the conditions prose; the lead ruled that the field a sentence landed in is an artefact of how the card was written and cannot decide the type, so this is treated the same as sahiwal-piciip-land-and-sewage.
